title: NYISO P-34 PAR Flows index
location: Index title and monthly archive list
finding: Official index identifies this report as Phase Angle Regulator (PAR) Flows and provides the 2025 monthly archives. The index does not define numeric positive-flow direction.

title: NYISO Market Participants User Guide
access: official-domain indexed search excerpt; direct PDF returned JavaScript verification page
finding: Describes PAR data as external/internal tie-PAR flows and schedules identified by PTID, and identifies DAM PAR Schedule Diagrams as visual representations of those data. This establishes the relevant documentary reference but contains no PS33/PS34 direction in the accessible excerpt.

title: NYISO Winter2016-17 Operating Study Appendices
finding: PTIDs25118/25119 identify STLAWRNC230A-230C PS33 and230B-230D PS34. Separate line PTIDs25026/25037 identify StLawrence-Moses L33P/L34P. Equipment identity and name ordering do not prove the public telemetry sign.

title: IESO2024 Annual Planning Outlook: Ontario Transmission Interfaces and Interties
access: official-domain indexed search excerpt; direct open not accessible through web tool
finding: Identifies the two230kV StLawrence interconnection circuits as PAR-controlled. Reports the2018 L33P PAR failure and replacement of the PARs in2022/2023, restoring import capability and flow control. This supports a changed control-regime hypothesis without proving P34 sign.

title: NYISO Parflow Diagrams, published12/16/2014; mirrored as DAM PAR Schedule Diagram
access: search-indexed transcription readable; download link returned403 and page retrieval via urllib returned403; no bypass attempted
finding: The transcription identifies StLawrence PTIDs25118/25119, a convention effective12/10/2014, and a legend that positive flow follows an arrow. Arrow geometry is absent from the transcription, so neither orientation can be established. Treat this mirror as a discovery lead, not verified direction evidence.

title: IESO Monthly Day-Ahead Historical Interface Schedules and TTC help
finding: This particular IESO report defines positive values as Ontario exports and negative values as Ontario imports. That report-specific convention cannot be transferred to NYISO P34 without a matched independent StLawrence measurement. No such matched measurement was established in this audit.
